items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: I knew him very well. I knew him here before he ever went to New York.

ctx.x: At Rossiter published that. Oh, one time Jelly told some friends of mine that that name Jelly Roll was given to him here in Chicago. Right here, I gave it to him. You really? Yes, because I was making records.
I was just getting ready to start making records. And it was called Jelly Roll. He wasn't named Jelly Roll then, but... What is his first name? Fred?
